question: Can a spaceship enter a black hole and return?
short_answer: No spaceship can enter an event horizon and return because escape velocity inside exceeds light speed and all internal paths lead to the singularity.
full_explanation: Even if a ship survived tidal forces, firing thrusters inside the event horizon only accelerates the ship faster toward the singularity.
